observations: Project page describes server tools, model instructions and post-processing for generated web pages; do not infer implementation of every product surface.
The research project reports human preferences on 100 sampled prompts when generation speed is ignored; this is not an accessibility, educational efficacy or performance guarantee.
limitations: One collage inspected; demo viewer shells returned no readable interactive content. No actual demo interactions, timing or product behavior tested.
No redistribution of original bytes; website-level CC BY-SA statement does not establish individual asset rights.
